standard-dialogue-collecting-the-duck.text: The duck recognises your boat and climbs aboard. He shares the secrets of the currents he travelled on with you.

standard-dialogue-inspecting-the-duck.text: This duck can be used to chart the currents of the sea. Place him in an area where you wish to chart currents, then collect the duck from wherever he ends up.

standard-dialogue-lacking-level-requirem.text: You doubt your ability to track the currents here due to how fast the water is flowing. Your current duck looks you in the eye to let you know he also doubts your ability. You'll need a Sailing level of 78.

standard-dialogue-dismissing-the-duck.text: You dismiss the duck and he flies away.

overhead-dialogue.text: Periodically, while at the end of the current:

historical-march-2025-sailing-alpha-depl.text: You release your current duck and it begins tracking the currents.

historical-march-2025-sailing-alpha-depl.player: There it goes! Now to follow it and see where this current flows.

historical-march-2025-sailing-alpha-coll.text: The duck recognises your ship and climbs aboard. It shares the secrets of the currents it travelled on with you.
